headline: Record prices offset lower output and rising costs

kpis.label: C1 cash cost (Cu, net of by-product credits)
C1 cash cost (Cu, net of by-product credits)

summary_short: Revenue of $739.7M USD (+36.2% y/y) and record adjusted EBITDA of $354.0M (+64.2% y/y) as a $6.22/lb realized copper price offset a 9.9% y/y drop in output; C1 cash cost rose to $2.82/lb. 2026 guidance reaffirmed.
summary_long: Revenue rose 36.2% y/y to $739.7M on a $6.22/lb realized copper price (up from $4.39 y/y), even as consolidated copper production fell 9.9% y/y to 51,759t. Adjusted EBITDA of $354.0M was a seventh straight quarterly record, up 64.2% y/y. Net income was $74.3M ($0.10/share), up from $24.0M ($0.03) y/y but down from $102.5M ($0.13) q/q. C1 cash cost rose to $2.82/lb (+$0.37/lb y/y) on lower volumes and higher diesel and acid prices. Mantoverde sulphide hit a record 18,190t on higher throughput and 90.2% recovery, aided by stronger gold credits. Net debt fell to $674.9M (-$62.6M q/q) on $367.1M cash and $715.4M undrawn RCF. The company reaffirmed full-year 2026 guidance: 200-230kt copper, C1 cash cost $2.45-2.75/lb, and $790M capex.
confidence_notes: The shard's eventDate (2026-06-30) is the fiscal quarter-end placeholder; the actual report/release date was 2026-07-30 (confirmed by the press release's own publish timestamp) — reported_at above uses the authoritative release date. Capstone reports in USD; the Yahoo-fundamentals-timeseries shard mislabels revenue/NI/EBITDA unit as CAD — the company's own USD figures from the release are used throughout this summary and match the shard's numeric values. Adjusted EBITDA ($354.0M, company definition) differs from the shard's mechanical EBITDA actual ($316.6M) because the company excludes non-recurring items — same divergence pattern as Q1. AISC is not published; Capstone discloses only C1 cash cost, so no C1-vs-AISC conflation risk this quarter. The 'vs guidance' delta on C1 compares a single-quarter actual ($2.82/lb) to the full-year guidance midpoint ($2.60/lb, from the $2.45-2.75/lb range); the quarterly figure exceeding the annual range's upper bound is not itself a guidance miss since the company explicitly reaffirmed the full-year range unchanged. Net-debt q/q delta uses the Q1 2026 actual ($737.5M, from our own prior validated Q1 summary) since the release's own comparator is Dec 31 2025 ($780.1M), a different basis.

drivers.explanation: Higher realized copper, gold and silver prices combined with strong operating performance drove the 36% y/y revenue increase despite lower copper volumes.
Seventh consecutive record quarter, supported by improved copper production at Mantoverde and Mantos, and strong realized copper prices.
Lower production at Mantos Blancos and Mantoverde cathode (a deliberate heap-throughput reduction under a cash-flow optimization strategy) outweighed a record sulphide quarter at Mantoverde.

drivers.metric: C1 cash cost (Cu, net of by-product credits)
drivers.explanation: Lower production volumes and higher diesel and sulphuric-acid input costs pushed consolidated C1 up; Mantos Blancos costs rose specifically on lower payable copper output and higher diesel-driven mining cost.
Higher realized copper prices lifted earnings from mining operations y/y; the q/q decline versus Q1 was not separately explained in the release.

Prices carried the quarter again — realized copper $6.22/lb (+42% y/y) and record Mantoverde sulphide output/recovery offset lower group volumes and rising input costs; full-year guidance held unchanged.
